<observations>
Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User wants modern island with integrated sink, cooks Italian. General contractor quote: $18,400 (updated to $21,250 on May 7; appliance allowance $6,300 set May 21).
* 🟡 (07:30) Agent coordinated $515 undermount sink, matte black faucet with pull-out spray, and soap dispenser. Pet dog: Bella. Fixture deadline May 10.

Date: May 7, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User approved brushed nickel cabinet hardware, $4,200 quartz waterfall slab, and herringbone backsplash. Pet cat: Whiskers. Backsplash deadline May 12.
* 🟡 (14:35) Agent confirmed waterfall slab delivery for May 15 (9 AM-12 PM).

Date: May 10, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User requested pull-out pantry drawer, pot-filler faucet PF-250 ($420), and appliance deadline May 18. Partner prefers "Arctic Fog" walls ($45/gal).
* 🟡 (12:35) Agent sourced ChillBox CB-300 under-counter fridge ($1,120) and GreenThumb herb kit ($85) for May 20 dinner.

Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User confirmed "Calacatta Gold" quartz island ($4,750), brushed nickel handles ($12/ea), and set lighting approval milestone for May 16.
* 🔴 (14:10) **Rule:** Always send photos before opening walls.
* 🟡 (10:00) Agent scheduled installer site visit for May 15, arranged pet-care kit for cat Luna ($85), sourced BrightBeam 3000K LED strips ($68), and VinoVault VC-210 wine cooler ($920).

Date: May 17, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User confirmed Oakridge 'LunaSeries' matte white cabinets ($1,850/ea, delivery June 5), 'Arctic Pearl' glass tiles ($42/pk), and requested plumbing permit by May 22. User out of town May 24-26 (demo delayed to May 27).
* 🟡 (12:25) Agent submitted plumbing permit (PR-2026-517), scheduled CityPower electrical inspection for May 20, ordered 'Eclipse' matte black faucet handles ($135), and added built-in coffee station for June 12 brunch.
* ✅ (14:45) Agent uploaded revised 3-D kitchen model showing cabinets, backsplash, coffee station, and faucet.

Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User selected StoneCraft "RiverEdge" light gray quartz countertops ($3,200/slab, delivery June 8), EcoTemp Pro smart thermostat, and noted $6,300 appliance allowance. Hosting dinner June 20.
* 🟡 (08:15) Agent ordered 3 RiverEdge slabs, LuminaLighting "Nimbus" brushed nickel pendants ($89/ea), ChillBox C12 wine cooler (150W), and EcoTemp thermostat (ET-2026-09, install June 15).
* 🟡 (11:05) Agent booked inspections: CityPower electrical (May 20), WaterWorks rough-in (May 28).
* ✅ (14:00) Agent uploaded revised floor plan and sent milestone summary email (countertop June 8, lighting June 13, thermostat June 15).
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Managing kitchen remodel selections, tracking the $6,300 appliance allowance, and coordinating upcoming inspections.
- Secondary: Upcoming milestones — CityPower electrical inspection (May 20), demo delayed to May 27 (user out of town May 24-26), countertop delivery (June 8), lighting install (June 13), and thermostat setup (June 15).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've updated the kitchen floor plan, tracked your $6,300 appliance allowance, and confirmed your upcoming inspection schedule (CityPower on May 20, WaterWorks on May 28). How would you like to proceed with the remaining selections?"
</suggested-response>
